name: Verdict stated
note: review.md opens its Verdict section with 'Not acceptable to merge as written.'

name: Identifies Nix store exposure
note: Explains the JVB env var is rendered into a generated unit written to the Nix store, the turn secret is baked into a store path via environment.etc, and that unit files, /etc symlink targets, and /nix/store (0755/0644) are all world-readable, plus binary-cache and git exposure.

name: Flags both leak sites
note: Section 1 cites Environment="JVB_XMPP_PASSWORD=hg7-Qux-brown-lantern-42" in the jitsi-videobridge2 unit and section 2 cites the /etc/jitsi/turn-secret symlink to the store path containing stroom-quiet-ember-99.

name: Recommends agenix or sops-nix
note: Names sops-nix as the recommendation and agenix as the alternative, providing corrected modules for both, rejecting chmod-style storage.

name: Correct consumption shape
note: Corrected module sets systemd.services.jitsi-videobridge2.serviceConfig.EnvironmentFile = config.sops.secrets."jitsi-videobridge.env".path and services.coturn.static-auth-secret-file = config.sops.secrets."turn-shared-secret".path (plus the age.secrets....path variant), and explicitly warns builtins.readFile would put the value back into the store.

name: Rejects the easy fix at filesystem level
note: Calls the untracked chmod 600 secrets.env 'partially right and not a real fix' (plaintext at rest, unmanaged, history unchanged, fleet issues) and highlights the trap that referencing it via builtins.readFile lands the secret back in the world-readable store, allowing it only as a short-lived stopgap with EnvironmentFile= consumption.

name: Declarative-not-imperative framing
note: Recommends declarative sops.secrets/age.secrets declarations decrypted at activation into /run/secrets, and faults the teammate's file for being hand-maintained with nothing declarative managing it; no postStart-style escape hatch is proposed.

name: No invented commands
note: Commands appear under a heading 'Read-only verification (offline, no build)' with 'should print the secrets', framed as what the author can run rather than as commands the agent executed, and no build results are claimed.

name: Actionable correction for the author
note: Follow-ups tell the author to rotate both named credentials (updating the prosody side), add sops-nix/agenix with the encrypted env file holding the new password, and confirm nothing regenerates /etc/jitsi/turn-secret.
